dimensions.detail: The skill describes a China travel guide that searches flights, hotels, trains, attractions, visa, payment, communications, and transport information; its flyai CLI use and AliTrip booking guidance match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are travel-scoped and include URL-stripping and summarization rules, but the artifact references knowledge-base files and reference folders that are not included in this package, which may reduce reliability rather than indicate security abuse.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The body discloses a prerequisite to install the external @fly-ai/flyai-cli globally with npm, while the metadata only declares node as a required binary; users should understand that this depends on a separate CLI package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime authority is limited to a node tool with execution isolation and read-only parent-context access; shell use is limited to travel search commands and is proportionate to the stated function.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request persistence, background workers, credential access, local indexing, destructive commands, or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable adding the external flyai CLI from npm and sending travel search details such as cities, dates, and preferences to that service. Treat visa, payment, transport, and booking guidance as travel assistance and verify critical details with official providers before purchasing or traveling.
llm.summary: This travel skill is purpose-aligned and disclosed, with no scanner or artifact evidence of malicious behavior.
